title: Aina za Sentensi (Theme 12: Magonjwa yanayotokana na mienendo ya maisha)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child finds the word or structure that makes a sentence ambiguous, gives every meaning, and rewrites it with one meaning.
steps: Find the word or structure with two meanings.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child gives three meanings and rewrites one clearly.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Sentensi tata ina nini?" Kwa nini "maana moja tu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Sentensi tata ina maana zaidi ya moja.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni sentensi ipi ni tata?" Kwa nini "Mama anapika." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Sentensi tata inaweza kufasiriwa kwa njia mbili.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Sentensi tata hutokana na nini?" Kwa nini "matumizi ya herufi kubwa" si jibu sahihi?
Kuna njia nyingine ya kuielewa sentensi hii?
misconceptions.repair: Sentensi tata ina maana zaidi ya moja: eleza zote.

checks.question: "Wanafunzi walikula mbuzi" ina utata gani?
checks.answer: nyama ya mbuzi au mbuzi mzima (au majina)

checks.question: Ondoa utata: "Alimpa barua yake."
checks.answer: Alimpa barua ya Juma. (au: barua ya mwandishi)
